findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: project_status, list_escalations, run_legal_exposure_review, get_legal_exposure_findings, get_control_gap_findings, answer_request, signup, get_onboarding_status, open_dashboard, get_billing · Private data: create_project, cancel_roadmap_item, run_security_review, run_control_gap_review, get_control_gap_findings, signup, verify_email, get_onboarding_status, open_dashboard, list_github_repos, import_project · Public sink: create_project, submit_request, run_security_review, signup, verify_email, get_onboarding_status, open_dashboard, connect_github, get_billing · Destructive: set_product_vision, delete_project, run_security_review, run_legal_exposure_review, run_control_gap_review, import_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: project_status, list_escalations, run_legal_exposure_review, get_legal_exposure_findings, get_control_gap_findings, answer_request, signup, get_onboarding_status, open_dashboard, get_billing · Private data: create_project, cancel_roadmap_item, run_security_review, run_control_gap_review, get_control_gap_findings, signup, verify_email, get_onboarding_status, open_dashboard, list_github_repos, import_project · Public sink: create_project, submit_request, run_security_review, signup, verify_email, get_onboarding_status, open_dashboard, connect_github, get_billing · Destructive: set_product_vision, delete_project, run_security_review, run_legal_exposure_review, run_control_gap_review, import_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
